data.name: The Null Dream
data.detailed_description:
YOU KNOW IT IS A DREAM. THAT DOESN'T MAKE IT SAFE.

The Null Dream is a first-person psychological horror game set inside a dream built from familiar places, incomplete memories, and details that do not remain where they belong.

Explore alone or enter the dream with up to five other players. Search for answers, solve environmental puzzles, and pay attention to what changes around you.

THE DREAM DOESN'T STAY STILL

Rooms may change when you return to them. Objects can appear where they were not before. A familiar path may lead somewhere entirely different the next time you follow it.

The dream rarely explains what has changed - or why... You will need to notice the difference yourself.

LOOK CLOSER

There is no persistent HUD pulling your attention away from the world.

Examine your surroundings, interact with objects, follow environmental clues, and piece together information hidden within the dream. Details that initially seem insignificant may become important later.

THE SAME PLACE. A DIFFERENT EXPERIENCE.

Play in online co-op with up to five other players.

You may stand in the same room and not experience the same event. Something visible to one player may remain hidden from everyone else. Communication can reveal what the dream is showing - but it may also make you question whose version of reality is correct.

PIECE TOGETHER WHAT HAPPENED

The story is not presented in a simple order.

Discover fragmented memories, examine abandoned and distorted locations, and solve environmental puzzles to understand why you entered the dream-and what connects the people trapped inside it.

KEY FEATURES

  • First-person psychological horror focused on atmosphere, uncertainty, and exploration

  • Online co-op for up to six players

  • Player-specific experiences that may not be visible to the entire group

  • Changing environments that reward careful observation

  • Environmental puzzles and hidden clues woven into the world

  • A HUD-free presentation designed to keep your attention inside the dream

  • A fragmented story discovered through places, objects, and memories

CURRENTLY IN DEVELOPMENT

The Null Dream is currently in active development. The screenshots and footage shown on this page represent the current version of the game. Visuals and environments elements will continue to be refined as development progresses.

Every player enters the same dream.

Not everyone will remember it the same way.

data.short_description: The Null Dream is a first-person psychological horror game for one to six players. Enter a shifting dream, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover fragmented memories-while each player may experience something different. Will you stay a part of His collection forever?
data.supported_languages:
English*, German*, Polish*, French*, Italian*, Spanish - Spain*, Russian*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 lub AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT 12 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
